Chapter 999
Medical marijuana treatment centers

s. 999.01 Medical marijuana treatment centers

(1) This chapter states a rule of statewide concern for a medical marijuana treatment center.

(2) A license is required before cultivation or processing begins.

(3) Retail sale to the public is outside this section.

(4) A local government may not ban medical marijuana treatment center cultivation or processing. A center shall observe a setback of 500 feet from schools.

(5) Building, fire, and stormwater rules of general application still apply.
